lines.text: Rogue Talents: As a rogue gains experience, she learns a number of talents that aid her and confound her foes. Starting at 2nd level, a rogue gains one rogue talent. description.value:
As a rogue gains experience, she learns a number of talents that aid her and confound her foes. Starting at 2nd level, a rogue gains one rogue talent. She gains an additional rogue talent for every 2 levels of rogue attained after 2nd level. A rogue cannot select an individual talent more than once.

Talents marked with an asterisk add effects to a rogue’s sneak attack. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual attack and the decision must be made before the attack roll is made.

A rogue cannot choose a ninja trick with the same name as a rogue talent.

candidates.rationale: Complete Core Rulebook/Pathfinder Unchained class feature (Core Rulebook p. 68-69, Pathfinder Unchained p. 20-24) compared with the PRD capture (coreRulebook/classes/rogue.html:389,390; unchained/classes/rogue.html:414,415; ultimateCombat/classArchetypes/rogue.html:372) and PCGen (cr_abilities_class.lst:200; cr_abilities_class.lst:1616; pu_abilities_class.lst:224; pu_abilities_class.lst:587; uc_abilities_class.lst:1607). Granted by Rogue at level 2, Rogue (Unchained) at level 2 (Foundry class records; PCGen cr_abilities_class.lst:200, pu_abilities_class.lst:224). Its 18 everythingpath/ increments (rogue-rogue-talents, unchained-rogue-talent-N) take this assessment through attributionFrom; each increment's name was checked against its class table's row. Required notices PZO1110, PZO1118, PZO1131 (PZO1118 inherited: Ninja tricks and the rule that a rogue cannot choose one with a rogue talent's name (Ultimate Combat Ninja Trick rogue talent)), all reviewed with no hold in force. The sheet's missing calculations stay outstanding with the launch row's owner, never legal holds.
